text:
morgan: Quick deconflict — during today's quiet window the staged JS publish hung on `npm publish` with an auth error, Python wheel pushed fine. Seeing intermittent 401s from the release runner.
release-bot: [publish] npm publish @redwood/sdk-js 0.8.0 -> ERROR 401 (ci-45)
release-bot: [publish] python wheel redwood_sdk_py 0.8.0 -> OK
jess: Ugh. That would leave JS consumers hitting 404 if they rely on `next`. We should avoid half-releases. Recommend pausing the JS roll and reverting any tags.
sam: Agreed. Two quick options: 1) yank the `next` tag and set docs/dev examples back to 0.7.x; 2) if the auth issue is transient we can retry once after token refresh. I prefer conservative approach: pause + creds rotation.
morgan: My vote: pause now. Rollback rule: if any artifact fails auth during publish -> pause cross-lang release and block auto-retries. We burned time triaging these before.
lee: Note — the changelog includes deprecation copy for the sync client. That copy is embargoed until the public post. Keep that unchanged in the draft; update the release notes to say "JS rollout paused" without revealing embargoed details.
infra-bot: Detected repeated 401 signatures from ci-45 when contacting registry.npmjs.org. Suggest rotating release token in vault and re-running from a fresh runner.
jess: Rollback checklist I'm running through: a) remove `next` from npm: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js next`; b) set docs examples -> pin to 0.7.5; c) create a republish ticket and label `blocked-by: registry-auth`.
dev-bot: Action: pausing scheduled releases for repo `sdk-js` until manual resume. Next automatic attempt disabled.
morgan: I'm executing the dist-tag removal now. @release-bot please run the command on ci-45.
release-bot: running `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js next` from ci-45 (token: release-service)
release-bot: stdout: removed dist-tag 'next' from @redwood/sdk-js@0.8.0
release-bot: note: version remains addressable by exact semver, tag removed to prevent accidental installs by `next` consumers
sam: I'll open the creds rotation ticket and loop in infra. Also will update docs-site config to pin examples to 0.7.5 and add a banner in the internal docs: "Do not upgrade to 0.8.0 until republish confirmed."
lee: I'll redact embargoed text in public notes and add a small blurb in the internal release notes: "Publish paused due to registry auth; republish pending token rotation." Link bug: #459.
jess: Added rollback steps to `docs/release-playbook.md` including commands and a short decision tree for when to pause vs retry.
morgan: Devops ask: infra, can you confirm if other org tokens were impacted or just the release-service token?
infra-bot: Confirmed: only the release-service token used by ci-45 showed elevated error rates. No broader org token anomalies detected.
dev-bot: Scheduling: releases for sdk-js suspended until 2024-11-02 or manual resume by repo-admin.
morgan: Good. Last item: if this blocks a security hotfix we can upload a signed tarball to the CDN as a manual emergency path — include instructions in the republish ticket.
sam: Noted. I'll include steps and test vectors for verifying the CDN artifact.
morgan: OK closing thread. If anyone wants this kept open for the creds rotation, ping me.
